messages:
ana: Quick heads-up — LyraX-8B int4 onboarding is showing a deterministic loop in long summarize jobs (>2k tokens).

sam: Can you paste the exact run command + seed so infra can repro?

ana: `python run_gen.py --model lyrax-8b --quant int4 --max-tokens 2500 --seed 42 --task summarization`. fp16 clean, int4 loops around token ~2130 repeating a short phrase.

carla: Any warnings during conversion? rotary/proj-order notes?

ana: Conversion log had: `WARN: rotary_scale changed 1.0->0.9 for head-group 5` and kvcache printed `head_offset +1` for some shards.

dmitri: Likely headmap/proj-order mismatch or rotary angle wrap. Two immediate mitigations: (1) runtime fallback to int8 for long requests, (2) test head-swap to confirm mapping.

ana: Ran head-swap locally; loops reduced but ROUGE dropped ~0.7 vs fp16. Also ran token-diff -> 20 token-split mismatches (ZWJ and composed accents).

ci-bot: queued eval 6001 (fp16 / int4 / int4+swap / int4+tokfix). ETA ~10m.

ana: Short-term plan: enable `--quant-fallback-threshold 1500` to auto-fallback to int8 for long requests, land tokenizer normalizer (NFKC) + conversion mapping fix. Run 72h staging smoke.

sam: Add regression test `tests/onboard/lyrax_longctx_repro.txt` and CI headmap roundtrip check.

ci-bot: eval 6001 complete: fp16 ROUGE-L=42.0; int4(raw)=38.4; int4+swap=40.1; int4+tokfix=41.6; int4+fallback=41.7.

carla: Fallback gives best quality for now. Track p99 latency and cost when it triggers.

dmitri: I'll add sliding-window perplexity to the onboarding harness to detect early drift in future onboards.

sam: Thanks — please post the curl repro for ops.

ana: repro curl: `curl -sS -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @repro_lyrax_longctx.json`

ana: Will merge PRs for convert/tokenizer/runtime flags and enable fallback flag in staging canary. Monitor and revert if error-rate spikes.
